E1.evidence: Issue #140 shows the declared names with `ros2 param list` on the reporter's camera node (".color.image_raw.format", ".color.image_raw.jpeg_quality", ".color.image_raw.png_level") against the documented `<base topic>/<transport name>/<parameter name>` form, and maintainers confirm the defect: "I had no intention to declare parameters against documentation. Most probably a mistake." (lukaszmitka) and "I would agree that this is likely a mistake." (mjcarroll).

E2.evidence: Step 1: compressed_image_transport (the publisher plugin that declares its parameters on the host node) and a separately built consumer that sets those parameters by the documented, transport-scoped names (host-node configuration or parameter client; not identified in the source). Step 2: the defect is a parameter name crossing the boundary: at the humble revision the plugin declares `param_base_name + ".format"` / `".png_level"` / `".jpeg_quality"` without the transport name, whereas the documented convention (and the ROS1 revision of the same plugin, whose dynamic_reconfigure server lives in the transport's own namespace) places them under `<base>/compressed/`. Step 3: the resolving change renames the provider's declared parameters (a provider rename the consumer must follow), not deployment wiring. Step 4/5: not build or firmware.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: the reporter frames the defect as a ROS1-to-ROS2 migration deviation ("Is there a reason this was not taken into account when migrating from ROS1 to ROS2?"); a consumer written against the ROS1 compressed_image_transport interface (parameters under the transport namespace) meets the ROS2 humble provider whose names dropped the transport segment. Other readings are listed in notes (PAIR with a configuration following the documentation; CONCURRENT name clash between two transport plugins).

E4.evidence: No failed interaction is observed; the mismatch is stated at code level and confirmed by maintainers ("I had no intention to declare parameters against documentation. Most probably a mistake."). Outcome class undocumented.

units.name: compressed_image_transport
units.revision_basis: The reporter names only the distros ("Current behavior (ROS2 foxy and humble)"); the humble branch head on the issue date (2023-03-30) was ef9442d8e92c14dcb5ed9023b9577e6d9e5cad39 (2022-11-10, after tag 2.5.0), whose compressed_publisher.cpp declares `param_base_name + ".format"`, `".png_level"`, `".jpeg_quality"`. The fix (#143 publisher, merge 2bc3a64117c78df7c43898d099914134caf65f3e; #144 subscriber, merge b8ac0b4f67ecd2fe544fd1182c280cc7382d401c) was merged to rolling and released for rolling as tag 3.2.0 (b95daa8e7517bde3ef90d6f698f6e55149e3e336, 2023-05-08); iron tag 3.1.0 also contains #143 and #144. It was never merged to the humble branch (compare humble...#143 merge = diverged), so there is no humble resolved revision.

units.name: transport_parameter_consumer
units.revision_basis: No consuming configuration or tool is identified or quoted; the reporter's host node is a RealSense camera node (/camera/camera, per the PR #142 example with realsense2_camera), whose own configuration of these parameters is not shown. The resolution does not change the consumer.

failed_conditions.quote: I had no intention to declare parameters against documentation. Most probably a mistake.

loudness_evidence: No failure is observed; the report compares `ros2 param list` output with the documented names ("# this is artificial, what I would expect").

resolution.summary: Declare transport-scoped parameters `<image>.<transport>.<param>` (e.g. `.color.image_raw.compressed.jpeg_quality`) in the compressed publisher and subscriber, keep the unscoped names as deprecated aliases synchronized to the scoped ones, and warn when a deprecated name is set (#143, #144; analogous changes for compressed_depth_image_transport #145 and theora_image_transport #146). Released for rolling (3.2.0) and iron (3.1.0); not backported to humble.
resolution.evidence: No consumer configuration is shown working against the fixed provider. PR #142 (foxy-devel variant, not merged) shows realsense2_camera_node declaring both forms and warning, e.g. "parameter `.color.image_raw.format` is deprecated; use transport qualified name `.color.image_raw.compressed.format`"; PR #144 shows a screenshot with a camera driver, rqt_image_view and rqt_reconfigure "dynamically changing through deprecated and new parameter", without revisions.

notes: Choice of composition: the issue reports one plugin's parameter names deviating from the documented convention and asks why this was not followed "when migrating from ROS1 to ROS2"; no consuming unit or failure is documented, so the consumer is an unidentified excerpt unit with an empty section and the ROS1 revision 1.15.0 (7825def310eaab518da912bc491266e76eda8742, noetic) is an inferred built-against revision whose declarations match the documented form. The provider section for 1.15.0 quotes compressed_image_transport/cfg/CompressedPublisher.cfg (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_transport_plugins/blob/1.15.0/compressed_image_transport/cfg/CompressedPublisher.cfg) and the reconfigure-server line of compressed_image_transport/src/compressed_publisher.cpp (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_transport_plugins/blob/1.15.0/compressed_image_transport/src/compressed_publisher.cpp), plus the documentation lines the reporter quotes in #140 from the ROS1 image_transport wiki. Inventory names use the reporter's expected form on its camera node; ROS 2 uses '.' where ROS 1 uses '/'. Other compositions: (1) PAIR with a ROS 2 configuration that follows the documentation, same mismatch; (2) CONCURRENT clash between two transport plugins sharing `<base>.<param>` names, which the reporter raises with a hypothetical peer plugin named `my_transport` ("There is a clash between transports on parameter namespace.") and which the fix PRs give as a reason ("avoiding clash between parameters from image_transport plugins"). No such clash existed among the released plugins at the broken revision: compressed_depth_image_transport then read an undeclared root-level parameter (`node->get_parameter_or<int>("png_level", config_.png_level, kDefaultPngLevel);`) and theora uses different names; PR #145 notes that the deprecated names it introduces do clash ("Both plugins use `png_level` and clash on deprecated parameter name as mentioned in #140"). The Extend-Robotics fork commits are the PR branch commits; ros-perception 9965df17 is the iron cherry-pick of the compressedDepth change and 56d4a658 a cherry-pick of the theora change. The issue was reopened and finally closed 2023-05-12 after #145/#146.
